I reviewed the diff against the SUPERBOSS standing instructions and verified its claims directly rather than trusting the self-report.

**Verdict: reject** (tier1)

What checked out: the diff's citations to the actual architecture source document are accurate — line 79 (Prompt Compiler Engine), line 144 (Browser Execution Engine), and line 213-215 (Stage 1 Input Acquisition) all match verbatim, and it honestly discloses that "mode pill"/"option chain" aren't literal document text.

What didn't check out: the diff claims specific Owner quotes ("FOR END USER THE BROWSER IS THE ONLY WAY TO INTERACT WITH THE SYSTEM", "dynamic mode pills + dynamic option chain", etc.) are "quoted in full" in `ai-os/OWNER_DECISIONS_NEEDED_2026-07-23.yaml` under a specific id. I read that entry directly — it contains only a paraphrase, not those verbatim phrases, and none of them appear anywhere else in the ai-os tree. That's a false evidentiary citation for a requirement that will drive real downstream engineering (new UI components, and a new mandatory AI-gateway call on every user request instead of only as an escalation fallback) once phase_2/phase_5 auto-dispatch into compliance-tracker. That mandatory-every-request AI call also isn't reconciled against the system's existing "software first, AI second, minimal credits only when needed" governance principle.

No `.github/workflows/**` files are touched. Verdict written to `review-verdict.json`.
